channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda dies at 90
item.description: The son of former Japanese leader Takeo Fukada became the country's first second-generation prime minister when he assumed office in September 2007.

item.title: U.S. military bans Chinese-made BYD cars from key air base in Okinawa
item.description: The move comes amid growing concerns about smart technology in the vehicles and the threat of spying.

item.title: Tomoka Nishiyama to become first woman to enter kishi shogi ranks
item.description: The holder of four women's shogi titles said she decided to enter Japan's regular professional ranks after considering her options for two weeks.

item.title: Yuri Yoshida rallies for first victory on LPGA Tour
item.description: Yoshida, 26, became the fourth player from Japan to win this season and the fourth first-time winner on the LPGA Tour.

item.title: Japan is known for world-class events - but the Asian Games were chaotic
item.description: Hotel chaos, transport mishaps and diplomatic blunders cast a spotlight on organisers and the firm hired to deliver the games.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
